content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/ salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IIT Roorkee Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 2 for Junior Research Fellow and 1 for Research Associate.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow: M.E/ M Tech. in EE/ EC/ Physics/ CS or equivalent with CGPA >= 6.0; or B.E./ B.Tech. in ECE, CSE, or equivalent with CGPA >= 7.5 (out of 10.0); or M.Sc./ MCA in Physics/ Instrumentation/ Electronics/ Computer Science& Engineering or Equivalent with CGPA>=7.5 and Qualified national level test (GATE/ NET/ etc.) or a degree from a CFTI Research Associate: PhD in EE/ EC/ CS/ Physics/ eqv. or 3 years' experience after M. Tech. in relevant domain

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow: Rs. 37,000/ - +HRA for 2 years; Rs. 42,000+HRA, after 2 years Research Associate: Rs. 58,000/ - + HRA for 2 years; then Rs. 61,000 +HRA

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow / Research Associate posts is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow / Research Associate posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced by IIT Roorkee for the Junior Research Fellow and Research Associate positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply for this recruitment by sending their application via email to the designated address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The salary for Junior Research Fellow is Rs. 37,000/- + HRA for the first two years, which will increase to Rs. 42,000 + HRA thereafter.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Research Associate position, candidates must have a PhD in EE/EC/CS/Physics/equivalent or possess 3 years of experience after M. Tech. in a relevant domain.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Roorkee recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow / Research Associate positions at IIT Roorkee will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Which state is IIT Roorkee located in?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Junior Research Fellow and Research Associate at IIT Roorkee are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
